tagline: Generate secure QR codes for any Odoo record with scan tracking and print options
problem: Most QR apps only cover invoices or sale orders. Teams need one secure engine for warehouse, CRM, products, and custom models.
solution: Token-based QR URLs, configurable payloads and actions, scan analytics, labels, and report blocks on any enabled model.
benefits: Works on any Odoo model via configuration
Secure token URLs with expiration and regeneration
Multiple QR actions: record, portal, PDF, custom URL
Bulk ZIP export and printable label templates
Scan statistics with user and device logging

features.title: Universal engine
features.text: One mixin and service layer for all models, no hardcoded document logic.

features.title: Secure scanning
features.text: Public /rn/qr/<token> route with access checks and login redirect.

features.title: Print and export
features.text: PNG, SVG, label PDF, A4 sheet, and report QR blocks.

features.title: Admin control
features.text: Templates, per-model config, ECC level, colors, and logo overlay.

seo_keywords: Odoo 20, Odoo Community, Universal QR, QR code generator, secure QR, warehouse labels, ARMORA IT Technologies
